content: Gemini response_schema via google-genai SDK has several limitations: the SDK-side validation rejects schemas containing 'additionalProperties' (use response_json_schema to bypass but lose Pydantic ergonomics). No support for polymorphic schemas (type-discriminated unions). When tool calls are present in message history, structured output fails on 2.5 models but works on 2.0 models. Inconsistent behaviour between 2.0 and 2.5 model families on json_mode vs structured output. Supported format values are date, date-time, duration, time.
